source_version_note: Current processed SILSO dataset; archived historical vintages not established. Results are retrospective hindcasts.
training_rule: Expanding window, observations through origin inclusive
target_rule: Targets after cutoff or provisional targets excluded
mase_definition: Mean absolute first difference of training SSN through each origin; per-forecast scaled absolute errors averaged by horizon and model

models.persistence: Forecast equals SSN at forecast origin
models.seasonal_naive_12: Forecast equals SSN 12 calendar months before target

limitations: Historical data revisions prevent strict real-time simulation.
Baselines are comparators, not evidence of model superiority.
